description: Snapshot one candidate, join configured review gates and opt-in automated proof, then repair and record the combined batch.

steps.label: Run Review And Automated Candidate Proof
Repair Current Batch Findings And Automated Failures
Skip Repair When Neither Branch Has Actionable Work
steps.question: Read the assigned exact batch disposition and matching automated result and child outcomes. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer yes only when trustworthy evidence establishes zero accepted actionable review survivors and zero actionable attributable automated failures, including a deliberately disabled automated branch. Otherwise answer no; preserve partial or unavailable coverage and never treat uncertainty as a pass or resurrect removed findings.

steps.label: Reingest Plan Scope After Repair Iteration
Stop When Batch Repair Is Settled Or Cannot Progress
steps.question: Read the exact current batch disposition, automated evidence, repair evidence, publication and reingest results. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer yes when every authorized actionable review finding and attributable automated failure is verified fixed, already resolved, excluded, or cannot safely make further progress; record incomplete evidence and genuine blockers. Answer no only while a distinct safe repair can make progress. Never claim missing or failed proof passed, resurrect gated findings, retry unchanged failures, or create deferred tasks.
